mapper.sql: id, symbol, group_code, tier_no, notional_lower, notional_upper, max_leverage, mm_rate, enabled
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_symbol_leverage_tier (id, symbol, group_code, tier_no, notional_lower, notional_upper, max_leverage, mm_rate, enabled) VALUES (#{id}, #{symbol}, #{groupCode}, #{tierNo}, #{notionalLower}, #{notionalUpper}, #{maxLeverage}, #{mmRate}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_symbol_leverage_tier SET notional_lower = #{notionalLower}, notional_upper = #{notionalUpper}, max_leverage = #{maxLeverage}, mm_rate = #{mmRate}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
